decision: Plan C+ slice 2 = first-party TS/JSX import extractor (extends the JS crawler — same ES-module shape) emitting ts_module nodes + ts_import_crawler coverage.
rationale: TypeScript/JSX is the next real evidence kind; the parser is ~the JS one (relative ES imports), so it's a small, verifiable slice.

decision: Documentation mockups (docs/design/**) and vendored skill rule-assets (claude/skills/**/assets) are NON-PRODUCT and excluded from the architecture model + coverage language scan, like node_modules/vendor. This is what honestly lifts DontPanic's own ceiling (its only TS/JSX is non-product), NOT ingesting mockups as architecture.
rationale: The 2026-06-08 audit capped the ceiling at low on docs/skill .tsx/.jsx; the truthful fix is scoping (those aren't the orchestrator's architecture), paired with a real extractor for first-party TS.

decision: Relative-path resolution only; no tsconfig path/alias or type analysis. Other languages (Swift/Gradle/Kotlin/Go/Rust) remain reserved + demand-gated by a governed target project that ships them — no validation surface for them in this repo.
rationale: Bounded + verifiable in THIS repo; speculative language extractors with no local validation surface are deferred until a real target needs them.
